collection.title: Peugeot 107 2005 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Peugeot 107 2005 - 2014 model requires a single 26" wiper blade and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. The type of wiper arm fitting for this model is the Standard Hook arm attachment. There is the option of upgrading to the newer Retrofit style wiper blade, we also have rear blade for this 107, simply click on the Rear Blades tab below.
